products.name: Windows Autopilot — Commercial
products.short_description: Ship new PCs straight to users for zero-touch setup. Stand up Autopilot yourself with self-guided, tested steps — for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Zero-touch device provisioning — no imaging, no technician

Manually imaging and hand-configuring every new PC is slow, inconsistent, and ties up a technician for every device. Windows Autopilot replaces all of that with cloud-driven provisioning: a new device ships straight to the user, who powers it on, signs in once, and walks away with a fully managed, policy-compliant, app-loaded workstation.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Windows Autopilot. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Autopilot works and which deployment mode to use.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify and implement if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune steps: auto-enrollment, registration, deployment profile, and Enrollment Status Page.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — hardware-hash collection, readiness discovery, validation, tenant reporting, and remediation.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Faster onboarding, perfectly consistent builds, and zero technician imaging — new devices are ready in minutes, not hours, and the process is identical every time.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Autopilot-Discovery.ps1 — Windows Autopilot device readiness check
    • Autopilot-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for Autopilot enrollment/sync issues
    • Autopilot-TenantReport.ps1 — tenant-wide Windows Autopilot device + profile report (Graph)
    • Autopilot-Validation.ps1 — confirm a device provisioned correctly via Autopilot
    • Get-AutopilotHash.ps1 — collect a device's Windows Autopilot hardware hash to a CSV

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
